derivation: A top-level fan-out has one frozen object; its region head routes to the fan-out join, and the join routes to an ordinary operation. The object's matching effect discharges its obligation, which completes the pass, so the join fires in the same transition: the object obligation becomes JOINED and the pass row is marked joined. LIFE-015 removes the joined FANOUT segment from the successor, retains the common outer prefix, here empty, and makes the successor's predecessor list the pass's completion frontier, the object occurrence. LIFE-001 gives an occurrence the innermost fan-out segment's key only when its enclosing path contains a fan-out segment; otherwise its object_key is null. The successor therefore has an empty enclosing path and a null object key, whatever the completed object's key was. No parent obligation exists, the instance stays ACTIVE, and the ROUTE detail names the object's relationship to the join, the join's outgoing relationship, and the fan-out.
